blocks.title: Slide 2
blocks.text:
THE ROLE
You don’t supervise a clinic. You own one.
Revenue and operations are one job. Run the branch as if it were yours, grow it, hold it to standard, and build a team that runs well without you.
1
Hold the standard
Clinical, operational and commercial, every day, with or without you on site.
2
Hold the team
Notice, develop and defend them. Correct in private, praise by name.
3
Hold the brand
When something goes wrong, the patient asks for you. Own it.
GLEUHR · BM Training · 02

blocks.title: Slide 6
blocks.text:
MODULES 1–3 · OPERATIONS
What to check in each team
Reception
Look up, smile, stand: “Welcome to GLEUHR”
Calls answered within 3 rings
Every enquiry logged in CRM
Anyone waiting 10+ min is acknowledged
Housekeeping
Washroom checked every hour
Cabin reset after every patient
Two-second test at the cabin door
Sharps and bio-waste by protocol
Therapists
Doctor sign-off before every procedure
Three rules: timer, verbal handoff, cabin log
Stop word given to every patient
Aftercare sent in writing
Coach privately, in under 10 minutes:
 name the moment, ask why, show the standard, practise once.
GLEUHR · BM Training · 06

blocks.title: Slide 7
blocks.text:
MODULE 4 · THE CRITICAL MODULE
The doctor is your peer
“Clinical is yours; operational is mine. The patient gets the best of both.”
Don’t manage her. Don’t be managed by her. Can’t agree? Take it to the RH, never around her.
Daily meeting · every working day
Target review
Client challenges
Operational issues
Clinical issues
Growth plan progress
One ask each
MoM the same day → RH, Manisha, Dr Kanikta
GLEUHR · BM Training · 07

blocks.title: Slide 8
blocks.text:
MODULES 5–6 · SALES
Check the quality, read the numbers
Every day, you
Watch at least 2 live consultations
Audit 5 CRM records from yesterday
Check follow-up calls were real, not dialled-and-dropped
Run the 6 PM counsellor debrief (15 min)
The five core numbers
Conversion to package
Total revenue vs target
Overall conversion rate
Upsell / cross-sell rate
Follow-up discipline
Counsellors never:
 use pressure or fake offers, quote a price by phone, recommend what the doctor didn’t, or take off-system payment.
GLEUHR · BM Training · 08

blocks.title: Slide 9
blocks.text:
MODULES 7–8 · LEADERSHIP
Plan the month, grow the team
Monthly Growth Plan: 6 sections
Last month’s performance
This month’s commitment
Top 3 issues to fix
Top 3 growth bets
Team development
Asks of corporate
A plan, not a report: 5 of 6 sections look ahead.
When someone is struggling
Talk in private
Give 3 specific examples
Ask before you correct
Agree the path together
Write it down; meet in 2 weeks
Develop first. Never protect a failing team member.

MODULE 9 · HARD LINES
Zero tolerance, most of all when revenue is at stake
Off-system payments
Cash off-books or a personal UPI
Outcome guarantees
“Guaranteed results in 4 sessions”
Floor-breach pricing
Discounts below the authorised floor
Fake conversions
Logging a sale with no real payment
Four more are in the Counsellor Playbook. Learn all eight by heart. One allowed in your branch means same-day review.

blocks.title: Slide 11
blocks.text:
MODULE 10 · BRANCH CONTROLS
Six controls HQ checks every day
Open at 9:30 AM
Opening photo shared by 9:45. Attendance and late arrivals reported.
Staff ready
Formal attire, badge, no round-neck T-shirts. Duties on WhatsApp.
Photo rounds
Every area, every morning and every 2 hours. Washroom photo at day-end.
Issue Tracker
Every issue has an owner and a date. Closed only with evidence.
Machines
One tracker entry per machine. Check it works before closing a repair.
CCTV
Recording on at all times. Verify it after every use of the app.
GLEUHR · BM Training · 11 · Rule: no closure without evidence

blocks.title: Slide 16
blocks.text:
PLAYBOOK · THE ESCALATED COMPLAINT
When a patient complains, in five steps
1
Listen fully
Sit beside her. Don’t interrupt or defend.
2
Say what you heard
“What I am hearing is…” Let her correct you.
3
Own it
“I am sorry. This is on me.” Never blame the team.
4
Fix it today
Offer something concrete before she asks.
5
Call back
On the day you promised. Document it within the hour.
“This is mine to fix, not yours to chase.”
GLEUHR · BM Training · 16

blocks.title: Slide 17
blocks.text:
THE BM CODE
Seven always, seven never
Always
Walk in warm, not tight
Meet the doctor daily; MoM the same day
Walk the branch twice a day
Make every callback you promise
Document complaints the same day
Tell HQ before they hear it elsewhere
Thank the team by name at close
Never
Blame a team member in front of a patient
Correct anyone in public
Decide a refund under pressure
Make a clinical decision
Pick sides in a team conflict
Go home with a complaint undocumented
Raise your voice on the floor
GLEUHR · BM Training · 17
